ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel field across the visible ventral surface, interrupted by high-intensity (white/tan) clusters occupying approximately 8-12% of the fluke's surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-tone region with dense concentrations of high-intensity circular pixel blobs localized at the lateral tips and along the trailing edge margins. Secondary sparse distribution of small high-intensity focal points across the central and lower regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the distal boundary; high-frequency alternating peaks and valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes, particularly pronounced on the medial sections of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex geometric curve along the lateral margins of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the outer edges and tips of both lobes; scattered individual circular anomalies visible across the central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light-colored rake marks or scratches) visible on the left fluke lobe, cutting across the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) localized on the distal margins and tips, creating a ragged, high-relief boundary profile.
